verdict.rationale: Claude's docs say individual users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy, covering conversation data and account user data. Enterprise adds a Compliance API for programmatic access to chat histories and file content. Nothing in the pack states the export format, and coverage of projects, memory, artifacts and files is not shown, so the 'all data in open formats' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented open export format (e.g. JSON/Markdown), explicit coverage of projects/memory/artifacts/uploaded files, account deletion/exit flow, independent hands-on corroboration.
